aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.subtitle: Your reliable partner in modern construction and engineering solutions

paragraphs: COSCO ENGINEERING is a reliable company providing modern construction, design, and engineering services in Uzbekistan.
Since 2017, we have been successfully implementing infrastructure projects and construction works for both public and private sectors.

Based on many years of experience, qualified specialists, and advanced technologies, Cosco Engineering follows high standards in engineering, project management, and construction. Our approach is to offer comprehensive and sustainable solutions for every project.
Today, COSCO ENGINEERING has established itself as a reliable and responsible partner in the country, standing out with its technical capabilities and commitment to quality.
We prioritize innovation, safety, and efficiency. Providing solutions tailored to our clients' needs is our main mission.

featuredProject.title: A confident step towards sports and a healthy lifestyle
featuredProject.description: The Boxing Skills School designed and built by Cosco Engineering is a modern, safe, and comfortable sports facility for professional athletes and the younger generation.
featuredProject.projectDescription: This school meets all international standards as a modern sports facility. The building includes professional boxing halls, training areas, modern changing rooms, and a medical service room. Special attention has been given to safety, ventilation, and energy efficiency.
